enabled.description: Whether the server is active and accepting connections.

server_name.description: Publicly visible name of the server (appears in server browsers).

admin_email.description: Contact email for server administration and support requests.

public_host.description: Publicly advertised hostname or IP address used to connect to the server (must be reachable by players).

udp_port.description: UDP port for game traffic (standard BZFlag game port).

http_port.description: TCP port for HTTP status and query endpoints.

max_players.description: Maximum number of simultaneous players allowed on the server.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before a player is automatically kicked (0 = disabled).

flag_respawn_time.description: Seconds between when a flag is dropped and when it respawns at base.

game_duration.description: Length of each match in seconds; set to 0 for infinite duration (rotates maps instead).

password_protected.description: If enabled, players must provide the game password to connect.

game_password.description: Password required to join the server (only used if password protection is enabled).

team_balance.description: If enabled, the server automatically balances teams when players join.

team_rotation.description: Team assignment mode: 'none' (player picks), 'random' (auto-assigned), or 'fair' (balance team strength).

allowed_flags.description: List of allowed game flags (e.g., 'B', 'N', 'L') — empty list means all flags are allowed.

disallowed_flags.description: List of flags explicitly forbidden on this server.

admins.description: List of player usernames granted administrative privileges.

bans.description: List of banned players (by IP address or username).

items.description: IP address (e.g., 192.168.1.100) or BZFlag username to ban

allowed_networks.description: List of allowed network ranges in CIDR notation. Use 0.0.0.0/0 to allow all IPs.

log_level.description: Verbosity of server logs: 0 = silent, 1 = minimal, 2 = normal, 3 = verbose, 4 = debug.

log_file.description: Filename for server activity logs (saved under /var/log/bzflag/).

map_rotation.description: Ordered list of map files to use in rotation (must be installed in /usr/share/games/bzflag/maps/).

http_stats.description: If enabled, exposes an HTTP endpoint for real-time server statistics.

http_stats_interval.description: Seconds between updates to the HTTP stats page.

replay_enabled.description: If enabled, records gameplay replays for later viewing.

replay_directory.description: Directory where replay files are stored.

replay_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain replay files before automatic deletion.

ground_vehicle_physics.description: If enabled, uses realistic ground vehicle physics (tanks slide, roll, and drift).

wall_jump.description: If enabled, allows players to bounce off walls during jumps.
